name: AMD Ryzen AI 300 "Strix Point" (Radeon 890M)
memory_note: MEASURED on one laptop (HP OmniBook Ultra 14, Ryzen AI 9 HX 375, 32 GB LPDDR5X-7500): the GPU's GTT is half of RAM by default (mem_info_gtt_total 16.19e9 = 15.08 GiB), and loom-serve must stay inside it. --memory_bytes above the GTT registers, then every weight load fails. 14e9 is that machine's value; another Strix Point laptop scales with its RAM (budget = min(GTT, 60 % of RAM) - 1 GB)

strix-point.name: AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 375 "Strix Point" (gfx1150, LPDDR5X-7500)
strix-point.note: SPEC, not measured: LPDDR5X-7500 on a 128-bit bus = 120 GB/s peak (mclk 937 MHz x 8; HP OmniBook Ultra 14); 16 CUs x 512 x 2.9 GHz = 23.8 TFLOP/s dense f16 WMMA. Replace bw with a measured streaming rate (Strix Halo reaches 216 of 256 peak). A Strix Point laptop with DDR5-5600 SODIMMs has 89.6 GB/s peak: bandwidth is per laptop, not per chip

runner.note: no DevLab runner: measured on a local laptop with .github/scripts/devlab_perf.sh (the card harness); fill labels with a runner's labels (and always include Linux) once one is registered
